rationale: The workflow is a single shellcheck lint job with no matrix, dependency installation, or test step. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by the pattern catalogue and by a measured fork experiment on an analogous lint/checks workflow that added timeout-minutes: 5 and reduced median elapsed time by about 26.8%. Repository CI history shows all five recent runs succeeded in roughly 24 seconds, so a five-minute budget gives ample headroom and will not interrupt valid runs, while bounding runaway or hung-step consumption. The change adds only timeout-minutes to the existing job; all steps, permissions (contents: read, security-events: write), runner hardening, checkout, and shellcheck invocation are preserved, and no permissions are weakened, no secrets added, and no new network or deployment operations introduced.
